svg.title: TOPAK I10 — RunConfinement.tla: every effect admitted under a Contained Run lease reached its tool's declared target, through a tool something holds to its channel. Two invariants, each with the mutations that break it: checked by TLC with and without D-0034-5's filter, proved by TLAPS
svg.desc: The module ADR-0034 A2's ratification condition (ii) asks for, drawn from its own text and from every results file about it, all read at build time: the tools and what holds each to its channel, the mechanism's check and the tool host, the two properties, every mutation by every property under each declaration, the witnesses, A2's condition and its Met line compared with the rows, every theorem and lemma, and the certified run. What is checked or proved here is of the module and not of the reference: only P4 is modelled, and what a tool says on its channel is not (its header). A2 was ratified on 2026.10.04 in Batch 30; the module's header, written before, calls it pending.

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

text.tspan: What holds a tool to its channel, by kind (the module's header)

svg.text: wasm: the runtime: the module's one network capability is its declared target (A2 P4; topak-contain wasmtool). A check, by construction
filtered: a native tool behind an egress filter in the tool host (D-0034-5). A trust, held only when the deployment declares it (Filtered)
native: nothing (D-0034-6; ADR-0045 T-0045-24 excluded)

text.tspan: What the module does not model

svg.text: "Only P4 is modelled. A lease here is attested at its declared rung, its Persona in house and the criterion in force, so Contained reduces to the profile's P4; those conjuncts are Confinement_A1.tla's and ADR-0034 §4's" (the header).
"What a tool says on its channel is not modelled: fidelity is about which channel, not what is said on it" (the header).

text.tspan: The mutations: what each does, where it acts, and what it must break
Why it must fail (the proof module's lemma)

g.text: the Wasm runtime does not bind the target. Must break EffectsOnDeclaredChannels.
Reach, line 62: CASE Kind[t] = "wasm" -> IF Mut = "M_CHANNEL" THEN Targets ELSE {Declared[t]}
the mechanism's check is dropped: a native tool is admitted under a P4-pass lease. Must break both.
Fidelity, line 67: Fidelity(p, t) == Mut = "M_NATIVE" \/ lease[p].p4 # "pass" \/ Held(t)
MutNativeAdmitsAll (line 172): Mut = "M_NATIVE" => \A p \in Principals, t \in Tools : Fidelity(p, t)
the egress filter does not bind. Must break EffectsOnDeclaredChannels when D-0034-5 is declared, and change nothing when it is not.
Reach, line 63: [] Kind[t] = "filtered" -> IF Mut = "M_FILTER" THEN Targets ELSE {Declared[t]}

svg.text: Every row's verdict is held by the diagram (13 rows) and compared with the file both ways. M_FILTER breaks EffectsOnDeclaredChannels where the filter is declared and changes nothing where it is not: "the filter is load-bearing only where D-0034-5 is declared".

text.tspan: Witnesses: each must be violated, so neither property is true by the model's construction

g.text: A Contained Run principal acts: the properties are not vacuous.
A Mediated Run principal acts too: Contained is not everyone.
The check fires: a native tool under a P4-pass lease is refused, with and without the filter.
An undeclared target is reached at all, by a Mediated principal's native tool: "the model lets a tool misbehave".

text.tspan: 's ratification condition (ii), and what was met at ratification
The condition, as the record states what the run showed

svg.text: "both invariants hold as specified and under D-0034-5's filter; M_CHANNEL and M_NATIVE break them as stated; a third mutation, M_FILTER, shows the filter is load-bearing
only where D-0034-5 is declared; five witnesses are violated" (ADR-0034 A2)
"Safe holds with and without the filter; M_CHANNEL and M_NATIVE break EffectsOnDeclaredChannels, M_NATIVE breaks ContainedEffectsUseHeldTools, and
M_FILTER breaks the first where D-0034-5 is declared" (ADR-0034 A2, ⟨B30⟩)
Each clause is a set of rows above, compared at build time: Safe holds with the filter (safef) and without (safe); ch and nat break EffectsOnDeclaredChannels, nath
breaks ContainedEffectsUseHeldTools; fil breaks it with the filter declared and fil0 holds without; five witnesses are violated.

\/ effects' = effects \/ /\ Fidelity(p, t) /\ \E tgt \in Reach(t) : effects' = effects \cup {[contained |-> Contained(p), tool |-> t, target |-> tgt]}

g.text: What an Actuate records, or that it changes nothing.
EffectsOnDeclaredChannels is kept unless M_CHANNEL, M_NATIVE, or M_FILTER with the filter declared.
For every behaviour, under those exclusions.
Why M_CHANNEL must fail: the Wasm tool reaches every target.

text.tspan: Mut = "M_NATIVE" => \A p \in Principals, t \in Tools : Fidelity(p, t)

g.text: Why M_NATIVE must fail: every tool passes the check.
Why M_FILTER must fail: the filtered tool reaches every target.
The native tool is held by nothing.
